original_card.question: Can the 64-per-call centre path (eight rank-8 COPY/ERASE totals through the private temporary) be shared across calls or shrunk?
methods: Derive a fully charged favorable relaxation for sharing one centre path across k calls, including restoration, hosting and precision.
Prove a lower bound on copied information per call for the selected decoder contract.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Show the changed centre charge and copy profile per call with every added restoration or hosting cost charged, and its ceiling via ceiling.ceiling(centre=...).

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write the per-call centre charge and copy children for sharing across k = 2 calls, charge the sharing overhead, and screen it; stop this route if even the ideal sharing gains under 10%. Ideal budgets: free 2.80x, shared by two 1.90x (levers.py).
original_card.bottleneck_link: The centre path consumes 64 of about 99.6 unpaid coordinates per call, i.e. about 64% of the raw deficit.
allowed_variations: One sharing pattern across a fixed number of calls.
One reduced copied-total contract for the existing decoder.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Removing copies without a replacement contract for the decoder's copied totals.

actual_scope: Independently audit discussion 1636's inherited fresh-window cover obstruction for its five-call mixed-center pilot on 112 ports and four stages; derive a three-center-bearing-pulse minimum for single-pass, no-return words of the same two-stream shear type.
scope_change_reason: Discussion 1636 already supplies a concrete shared-centre pilot and states a global routing failure. Testing that exact implication is its first falsification gate; no positive supplier or changed centre profile is claimed after the failure.
bottleneck_link: The 64-per-call centre path is a central cost. The audited five-call local identity cannot remove its charge under the inherited route because the same-cover block is wrong; a new route or paid intertwiner is needed before pricing a supplier.
stop_rule: Stop after the conditional route proof, all 50,176 stage/port pairs, exact 2x2 shear identities, controls and explicit limits. Do not search a new m83 geometry or claim candidate-specific supplier admission.
evidence: RESULT.json: 50,176 stage/port pairs from the selected-pinned route, exactly 448 fresh-preserving same-port pairs; reconstructed 112 Hamming sign lines have R^T R=14I and M_pp=0; rational five-call exchange at M=1,-13 (word parsed from the pinned discussion text) but, under multiplicative no-return projection, same-port block [[1,0],[131/144,1]], not exchange; symbolic two-pulse obstruction and attaining three-pulse projected word under multiplicative single-pass projection; two-port return-path counterexample when projection is not multiplicative; five failure controls. Conditional on discussion 1636's pinned (provisional) coefficients and on one-transition-per-fresh-stage/no-return routing, which is not derived for the five-call word.
author: Josie Elliston
ai_assistance: Substantial AI assistance: OpenAI Codex (offline session 14b) for the proof, independent GF(2) implementation, exact checks and documentation; Claude (Anthropic) for review, discussion pinning, scope narrowing and publication. No independent human review.
